 * Define and execute the New Product Introduction (NPI) strategy and plan in line with product roadmaps defined by Product Line Management, customer deployment requirements, market introduction milestones, and business objectives..

 * Drive deployment and operational industrialisation, ensuring installation, commissioning, configuration, migration, upgrade, troubleshooting, maintenance, and support processes are established, repeatable, scalable, and increasingly automated.
 * Prepare and coordinate first customer deployments, pilots, and early market introductions together with Services and Operations teams. Capture then field experience, issues, and lessons learned and driving them back into product, deployment, and operational improvements.

Your qualification
 * Degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline 
 * Several years of experience in NPI, Product Management, System Engineering, Solution Delivery, or Technical Programme Management.
 * Proven experience leading cross-functional product introduction, deployment, or technology transition initiatives.
 * Experience in mission-critical communications, telecommunications, or railway communication systems.
 * Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, release governance, deployment readiness, and operational support processes.
 * Knowledge of GSM-R, FRMCS, MCX, IP-based communication systems, or railway telecommunications is an advantage.
 * Fluent English, French and/or German a plus

Our offer
 * Community and Success-these are the values that define how we work together. Join our motivated, international team:
 * Open communication with a casual, first-name-only culture across all international locations
 * Flexible work hours and the option to work from home
 * An environment that welcomes new ideas and encourages initiative
 * Personalized training and professional development opportunities based on performance reviews
 * A modern office in the Vienna Technology Hub, surrounded by numerous restaurants and excellent infrastructure
 * Regular company events and team-building activities
 * Many attractive employee benefits (e.g., meal vouchers, workplace health promotion, company bike, additional vacation days for volunteer work and birthdays, transportation allowance)

We offer a competitive gross annual salary starting at EUR 70,000 per year. A higher salary commensurate with your actual qualifications and experience is possible.

jobs.description:
Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year lega... 1 Head of Project Execution (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers A Snapshot of Your Day

As Head of Project Execution (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers, you lead the organization responsible for managing the factory's customer order portfolio within an Engineering-to-Order business. You ensure the successful execution of projects from order intake to delivery, meeting targets for schedule, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction. In addition, you drive the transformation of the order management organization by strengthening project management excellence, advancing digitalization, and continuously improving processes and standards. In close collaboration with customers, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and senior management, you contribute significantly to operational performance, profitability, and sustainable business growth.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Lead, develop, and inspire the Order Management organization, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a high-performance culture.
 * Ensure the successful execution of the project portfolio in close collaboration with Commercial Project Management (CPM), managing project performance, risks, opportunities, profitability, quality, and customer satisfaction.
 * Drive organizational and process transformation, including the implementation of best practices, digitalization initiatives, and standardized project management methodologies.
 * Establish and continuously improve project management standards, governance, milestones, and quality gates in alignment with global business requirements.

What You Bring

 * Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a comparable field.
 * Extensive leadership experience in project management, order management, or a comparable function within a complex manufacturing or Engineering-to-Order environment.
 * Proven track record in leading organizational change, transforming processes, and driving continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
 * Strong expertise in project, risk, contract, and stakeholder management, combined with excellent communication, moderation, and decision-making skills.
 * Fluent German and English language skills and experience working successfully in an international and intercultural business environment.

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of € 84.028,28 gross/year for a full-time position, plus an All-In agreement including a variable compensation component.

jobs.description:
The University of Klagenfurt is pleased to announce an open faculty position in the Department of Economics, Analytics and Operations Research within the Faculty of Management, Economics & Law, in compliance with the provisions of Art. 98 (open-ended) or Art. 98 (limited to 6 years) of the Austrian Universities Act: 1 Full Professor of Production Management Referenzcode: 239/03-PERS/26 

Full Professor of Production Management

This is a full-time position. Whether the position will be implemented in compliance with the provisions of Art. 98 Austrian Universities Act as open-ended or limited to 6 years will be decided during the course of the appointment procedure, based on candidate qualifications and experience.

The professorship will be embedded in the Department of Economics, Analytics and Operations Research (EAOR, https://www.aau.at/en/economics/%29 within the Faculty of Management, Economics & Law (https://www.aau.at/wr). We are looking for a highly qualified and (in line with academic seniority) internationally recognised academic with high engagement in developing and sustaining an ambitious and innovative research programme.

The duties of the position include:

-Representing the fields of Production and/or Logistics Management in research and teaching

-Representing the EAOR-Department's Operations Research group in research and teaching

-Teaching in relevant study programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctoral level in English and German, including the supervision of academic theses. German language skills are not a prerequisite, but teaching ability and proficiency in German (Level B2) are expected within two years after appointment

-Acquisition and management of competitive research funding

-Collaborating with colleagues across the university and with external partners

-Advising and mentoring students and early career researchers

-Contributing to university governance and academic self-administration

-Engaging in third mission activities and public outreach

Required qualifications:

-Habilitation or equivalent qualification in a relevant field: Operations Research, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Management Science, Business Administration, or related fields

-Doctoral degree or PhD

-Excellent research standing and publication record in the field of the position

-Teaching experience at university level and didactic competence

-Experience in the acquisition of and/or willingness to apply for competitive third-party research funding, depending on career progression

-Fluency in English

Desired qualifications:

-Experience in interdisciplinary collaboration

-Integration in the international scientific community

-Experience in (co-)supervision of academic theses

-Experience in academic self-administration

-Social skills, competence in leadership and management of teams

-Competence in gender mainstreaming and diversity management

-German skills or willingness to learn German

The salary is subject to negotiation. The minimum gross salary for the position at this level (salary group A1 for faculty according to the Austrian Universities' Collective Bargaining Agreement) is currently € 93,986 per year.

For full details of this vacancy and the specific application procedure, please see https://jobs.aau.at/en/job/full-professor-of-production-management/.
